title: grep_search excludes build dirs and reports timeouts
description: grep_search now catches subprocess.TimeoutExpired and returns a helpful message instead of crashing. Excludes target/, .git/, node_modules/, __pycache__ via --exclude-dir. Output limited to 50 lines to prevent context overflow.
definition-of-done: 1. Timeout returns helpful message. 2. Build/VCS dirs excluded. 3. Output capped at 50 lines with count.
testing-plan: 1. Broad search path returns timeout message instead of crash. 2. Verify --exclude-dir flags present.
